residual.wall: The 512 is both Control and Bone. Takes bake the mesh, not the handles. There is Forwards (handles→hull) and no named Backwards (hull→handles). Dual: samples = handles.

question: What is Unreal Control Rig actually — elements, solve directions, spaces — and which of those laws split Gasper's cage from his handles without adding a second skeleton?
coordinateSpaces: UE: Bone / Control / Null / Space. Events: Construction (once), Forwards (controls→bones, every animate frame), Backwards (bones→controls, bake). Gasper: Contour512 (bone/skin), Stance sockets (controls), regions (nulls), orbit/identity (spaces). Content px. Phase φ.
physicalLaw: Controls are what you grab. They drive bone chains. Bones deform the mesh. Nulls group and transform; they are hidden by default (Epic Controls/Bones/Nulls).
Forwards Solve: controls affect bones. Primary. Runs continuously when animating in Sequencer / AnimBP.
Backwards Solve: bones affect controls. Inverse. Required to Bake Animation to Control Rig. No Backwards node ⇒ not in the bake menu.
Construction Event: once, post-init. Initial offsets of controls to bones. Spawn nodes only function here. Preview outlined red.
Backwards then Forwards (combo mode) is how a baked take sits on controls and still deforms.

Space: a control's parent transform (Parent / World / custom). Switch is one frame + compensating transform keys so the picture does not pop. Custom spaces should be Controls, not Bones — Bones as space cause cyclical rig errors.
IK and FK are two forwards recipes on the same bone chain. They are not two skeletons.
Modular rigs compose limb modules. Control Rig Physics / Dynamics (UE 5.8 beta) is a particle solver on the rig, not a second Event Tick.
artisticLaw: The animator never keys the 512. The animator keys Controls (handles, face, orbit). The 512 is the bone/skin that Forwards writes.
A take that stores raw 512 is a baked mesh, not a rig take. Paddle ghosts stick because we baked bones.
Home is Construction: rest offsets, once. Cook is Forwards: every frame.
Loading a take is Backwards then Forwards — sockets read the 512, then Forwards deforms from those sockets. Never leave the baked 512 as the live hull.
Plant is an IK space on the foot control. Swing is FK. Same control. Space switch, no pop.
Do not parent a handle to the 512 sample it drives.
invariants: 512 / 360 / 1000 stay the only deform domains. No second skeleton.
closedSpline is the only d. Forwards writes samples, not a new mesh.
No exec / Tick. Forwards is Anim-Graph cook, not Event Graph.
Mute Handles = Forwards passthrough (bones stay Construction rest).
failureModes: samples = handles → sculpt, walk, and takes overwrite each other.
Take = 512 floats with no Backwards → paddle / ghost silhouette sticks.
Parenting a control to the bone it drives → bake resets (UE known fail).
Space switch without compensating transform → face/orbit pop.
Calling Voigt the rig. Voigt is Dynamics on the bones after Forwards.
Adding a Maya-style joint hierarchy as a second writer.

Whether Backwards is a node (sockets from 512) or a bind at take-load.
Whether face-rig golden-ratio lock is a Space or a Construction offset.
tests: Handles muted ⇒ 512 equals Construction rest (height 168.3, W θ≈0.54).
A take play that only writes 512 without refreshing sockets is flagged as bone-bake, not a rig take.
Orbit space switch does not change identity yaw=8.
visualConsequences: Grid (skin/bones) can hide while handles still run Forwards.
Loading Rest after a paddle take returns Construction, not a ghost.
Foot plant holds in world space (IK space) while the swing foot is FK.
Monitor still shows Forwards output, never the raw take buffer.
implementation: Explore only. Do not add a joint skeleton. Do not recut FormMaster this deposit.
Name the split in the graph: Controls (handles, face, orbit) vs Bones (512, lattice, relief).
Construction = Identity rest offsets. Forwards = current cook. Backwards = take/mocap → sockets, then Forwards.
Voigt/κ stay post-Forwards Dynamics on bones, not controls.
